tytul: Canned cabbage with mushrooms: why not to can it
wstep: There is no recipe for canned cabbage with mushrooms here. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones. [T:SUS-035]
Wild mushrooms must not be canned. [T:SZY-020]

akapity: Fresh vegetables, except most tomatoes, are low-acid foods. [T:SZY-001]
Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning fresh vegetables, and a boiling-water bath means a real risk of botulism for them. [T:SZY-006]
According to Penn State Extension, cabbage is not suitable for pressure canning. [T:SZY-025]
In the NCHFP mixed vegetables recipe, cabbage must not be substituted for any of the vegetables. [T:SZY-022]
A boiling-water bath is suitable only for acid foods, such as sauerkraut. [T:SZY-054]
